cohort: 54 pregnant women diagnosed with acute uncomplicated appendicitis at the University of Hong Kong-Shenzhen Hospital between January 2015 and April 2019
finding: For pregnant women with acute uncomplicated appendicitis, antibiotic treatment was found to be a safe and feasible option with no significant difference in outcomes compared to appendectomy.
mod_finding: There was no difference in mode of delivery between the appendectomy group and the antibiotic treatment group.
